description: Cultural risk assessment for a hex value or palette (symbolic weight, regional taboos, religious associations, market flags). This is one component of colour_passport for single colours. Use colour_passport for a general profile; call this directly for palette-level risk checks or when cultural risk is the only thing being asked about.

hex.description: Single hex value to assess e.g. '#FF9900'

palette.description: Optional list of hex values to assess as a palette

name: colour_cultural_risk

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Assess Cultural Risk of a Colour or Palette
